title: Recover a consumer without losing the replay window
description: Model one consumer application's outage, then compare shared reads with enhanced fan-out and decide whether replayed records can repeat a business effect.

readModes.label: Shared GetRecords reads
readModes.detail: Consumer applications contend for the shard's shared read budget. The lab shows an equal-share planning estimate, not a scheduler guarantee.

readModes.label: Enhanced fan-out
readModes.detail: Each registered consumer receives a dedicated read pipe for every shard through SubscribeToShard.

sinkPolicies.label: Apply every delivery
sinkPolicies.detail: The destination does not claim a stable event ID before changing business state.

sinkPolicies.label: Claim the event ID atomically
sinkPolicies.detail: The destination records the event ID in the same transaction as the business mutation.
